title: Keyboard Manager Key Remapping Fails After Sleep or Startup

judgment.rationale: The issue still mixes at least two failure moments—startup and wake-from-sleep—and the current thread does not isolate whether the failure affects single-key remaps, shortcut remaps, or Keyboard Manager activation itself.
evidence: The issue body says remapped keys stop working after either sleep or automatic startup, but it does not separate those scenarios into a reproducible sequence.
The public comments are only '+1' reports plus one user asking for clearer steps, whether Keyboard Manager logs errors, and whether toggling the module restores behavior.

The attached public bug-report bundle I reviewed did not isolate a post-sleep failure signature; the Keyboard Manager logs mostly show startup and an editor-shortcut parse failure rather than a clear remap-engine crash.
The runner evidence showed other PowerToys activity, so the available data does not yet prove a general hook failure after resume.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a precise repro that separates startup from wake-from-sleep and a fresh post-failure bug report captured immediately after the remaps stop working.

fix_assessment.rationale: A fix should not be proposed until the failing trigger and affected remap class are narrowed to one reproducible path.

issue_context.summary: Keyboard Manager remaps reportedly stop working after startup or after the machine wakes from sleep, but the public issue and reviewed bug-report data do not yet isolate which trigger is real or which class of remap breaks.
known_information: The issue targets Keyboard Manager on PowerToys 0.100.2 from the Microsoft Store.
The body explicitly names two possible trigger moments: automatic startup and wake from sleep.
Multiple commenters reported seeing something similar, but none added precise steps or narrowed the failing remap type.
A public PowerToysReport ZIP was attached and reviewed locally during triage.
inferences: This could be a resume-state problem, a startup-timing issue, or a narrower remap-engine state problem; the current thread does not distinguish among them.
If only certain remap classes fail after resume, the next investigation needs that distinction before it can responsibly choose engine code to inspect.
issue_context.analysis: The request should stay lightweight. The existing public evidence is enough to know the issue is real for multiple users, but not enough to select a safe code path. A targeted follow-up can cheaply separate wake-from-sleep from cold-start behavior and identify whether the broken scope is all remaps or only a subset.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the full issue body, all comments, and the live labels from the GitHub issue.
Downloaded and unpacked the attached public bug-report archive for local inspection.
Reviewed Keyboard Manager module and engine logs from that bundle and did not find a single conclusive remap-engine failure that explains both startup and wake-from-sleep paths.
Reviewed runner evidence and noted that the available data did not prove a full PowerToys hotkey-hook outage.

information_gaps.information: A numbered reproduction sequence that separates the startup case from the wake-from-sleep case.
information_gaps.why_needed: The current body merges two different trigger moments, which blocks targeted debugging and regression checking.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please test each path separately and reply with exact numbered steps for the startup case and for the sleep/wake case, including when the remaps stop working.

information_gaps.information: Whether the failure affects single-key remaps, shortcut remaps, or both, and whether disabling then re-enabling Keyboard Manager restores behavior without restarting PowerToys.
information_gaps.why_needed: That tells maintainers whether the problem is a broad resume-state failure or a narrower remap-engine state transition.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please list one specific single-key remap and one specific shortcut remap you tested, note which one failed, and confirm whether toggling Keyboard Manager off/on restores them.

information_gaps.information: A fresh PowerToys diagnostic bundle captured immediately after the remaps stop working.
information_gaps.why_needed: The reviewed older bundle did not isolate the failing moment; a capture taken immediately after reproduction is much more likely to contain the relevant log window.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Right after the remaps fail, please comment /bugreport on the issue and attach the generated ZIP from that failing run.

actions.label: Separate startup and wake-remap failure
actions.note: Ask for the smallest issue-specific evidence that distinguishes the failing trigger and remap scope.
